result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it creates a mutual aggregate cap equal to the greater of twelve months’ paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000, retains the mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, includes all required uncapped carve-outs, and excludes Sparkling’s payment obligations from capped damages. The changes are targeted and preserve the original allocation of risk. Drafting is generally professional, although the retained final sentence creates some duplication and possible scope ambiguity by stating that all Section 15 limitations—not merely the cap—do not apply to breaches of Sections 13 and 14.
